passage.zh: 一般大眾常覺得每天都吃早餐的人比較聰明，檢視 1950 年到2008 年之間的相關研究後發現，吃早餐似乎只對經濟狀況較差的學生在學業表現上有幫助，而理由恐怕不是因為身體在早上需要營養。
passage.py: Yìbān dàzhòng cháng juéde měitiān dōu chī zǎocān de rén bǐjiào cōngmíng, jiǎnshì 1950 nián dào 2008 nián zhījiān de xiāngguān yánjiū hòu fāxiàn, chī zǎocān sìhū zhǐ duì jīngjì zhuàngkuàng jiàochà de xuéshēng zài xuéyè biǎoxiàn shàng yǒu bāngzhù, ér lǐyóu kǒngpà búshì yīnwèi shēntǐ zài zǎoshàng xūyào yíngyǎng.
passage.en: People commonly feel that those who eat breakfast every day are smarter. But after reviewing related research from 1950 to 2008, it was found that eating breakfast only seems to help the academic performance of students from poorer families—and the reason is probably not that the body needs nutrition in the morning.

passage.zh: 主要是貧窮孩子被當時學校供應的免費麵包和牛奶給吸引，才乖乖來上課。
passage.py: Zhǔyào shì pínqióng háizi bèi dāngshí xuéxiào gōngyìng de miǎnfèi miànbāo hé niúnǎi gěi xīyǐn, cái guāiguāi lái shàngkè.
passage.en: It was mainly that poor children were attracted by the free bread and milk the schools provided at the time, so they dutifully came to class.

passage.zh: 2014 年，荷蘭一群研究者設計了一個實驗，他們發現參與實驗的 30 位大學生在沒吃早餐的情況下，測驗的成績較為突出。
passage.py: 2014 nián, Hélán yìqún yánjiūzhě shèjì le yí ge shíyàn, tāmen fāxiàn cānyù shíyàn de 30 wèi dàxuéshēng zài méi chī zǎocān de qíngkuàng xià, cèyàn de chéngjì jiàowéi tūchū.
passage.en: In 2014 a group of Dutch researchers designed an experiment and found that the 30 university students taking part scored better on tests when they hadn't eaten breakfast.

passage.zh: 心理學家卡斯楚也發表過很多關於早餐的論文，他認為吃較多的早餐能讓肥胖者午、晚餐吃得較少，最後達成瘦身的目的。
passage.py: Xīnlǐxuéjiā Kǎsī Chǔ yě fābiǎo guò hěnduō guānyú zǎocān de Lùnwén, tā rènwéi chī jiào duō de zǎocān néng ràng féipàngzhě wǔ, wǎncān chī de jiào shǎo, zuìhòu dáchéng shòushēn de mùdì.
passage.en: Psychologist Castro has also published many papers on breakfast. He believes eating a bigger breakfast lets overweight people eat less at lunch and dinner, eventually helping them lose weight.

passage.zh: 但康乃爾大學的研究指出，早上吃很多的人，並不會減少吃午飯的量，經過仔細的計算，一天下來吃進肚子裡的食物總量反而增加。
passage.py: Dàn Kāngnǎi'ěr dàxué de yánjiū zhǐchū, zǎoshàng chī hěnduō de rén, bìng búhuì jiǎnshǎo chī wǔfàn de liàng, jīngguò zǐxì de jìsuàn, yìtiān xiàlái chī jìn dǔzi lǐ de shíwù zǒngliàng fǎn'ér zēngjiā.
passage.en: But research from Cornell University found that people who eat a lot in the morning don't eat less at lunch; after careful calculation, the total amount of food eaten over the day actually increased.

passage.zh: 究竟是吃早餐好？還是不吃早餐好呢？我覺得，餓了就吃最自然。
passage.py: Jiūjìng shì chī zǎocān hǎo? Háishì bùchī zǎocān hǎo ne? Wǒ juéde, è le jiù chī zuì zìrán.
passage.en: So is it better to eat breakfast or not? I think eating when you're hungry is the most natural.

passage.en: In the film, several snakes surround a baby marine iguana. Because these snakes can't see very clearly and can only sense movement, the little iguana at first stays completely still so the snakes won't notice it.

passage.en: Unexpectedly, a snake suddenly lunges from behind, and the little iguana has to start running wildly—but running attracts even more snakes.

passage.zh: 途中牠一度被蛇群抓住，但牠幸運溜走，最後跳上一顆大石頭，痛快地把張大嘴巴、準備大吃一頓的蛇全都甩在腦後。

passage.en: On the way it is caught by the snakes at one point, but it luckily slips away and finally jumps onto a big rock, gleefully leaving behind all the snakes that had opened their mouths wide, ready for a big meal.

passage.zh: 這部影片不止記錄了這又驚又險的過程，還配上了用心挑選的演奏樂曲，讓許多觀眾都大讚這簡直是一部動作電影，冷靜勇敢的小海鬣蜥更堪稱動物界的最佳主角。
passage.py: Zhèbù yǐngpiàn bùzhǐ jìlù le zhè yòu jīng yòu xiǎn de guòchéng, hái pèishàng le yòngxīn tiāoxuǎn de yǎnzòu yuèqǔ, ràng xǔduō guānzhòng dōu dà zàn zhè jiǎnzhí shì yíbù dòngzuò diànyǐng, lěngjìng yǒnggǎn de Xiǎohǎi lièxī gèng kānchēng dòngwùjiè de zuìjiā zhǔjué.
passage.en: The film not only records this thrilling, dangerous escape, but is also set to carefully chosen music, so that many viewers praised it as practically an action movie, and the calm, brave little marine iguana can truly be called the best leading role in the animal kingdom.

passage.zh: 2011 年，研究人員找了 59 人，分別以七種不同語言大聲讀出 20篇相同的短文。
passage.py: 2011 nián, yánjiū rényuán zhǎo le 59 rén, fēnbié yǐ qīzhǒng bùtóng yǔyán dàshēng dúchū 20 piān xiāngtóng de duǎnwén.
passage.en: In 2011, researchers had 59 people read aloud the same 20 short texts in seven different languages.

passage.zh: 他們發現，被大眾認為語速極快的日語和西班牙語，每秒音節數最多；
passage.py: Tāmen fāxiàn, bèi dàzhòng rènwéi yǔsù jíkuài de Rìyǔ hé Xībānyáyǔ, měimiǎo yīnjié shùzuìduō;
passage.en: They found that Japanese and Spanish, which the public considers extremely fast, had the most syllables per second;

passage.zh: 華語是這七種語言中速度最慢的，接著是德語。
passage.py: Huáyǔ shì zhè qīzhǒng yǔyán zhōng sùdù zuìmàn de, jiēzhe shì Déyǔ.
passage.en: Chinese was the slowest of the seven languages, followed by German.

passage.zh: 研究人員進一步計算每種語言所含的資訊量。
passage.py: Yánjiū rényuán jìnyíbù jìsuàn měizhǒng yǔyánsuǒ hán de zīxùn liàng.
passage.en: The researchers then calculated the amount of information each language contains.

passage.zh: 他們發現，西班牙語每個音節傳達的資訊很少；
passage.py: Tāmen fāxiàn, Xībānyáyǔ měi ge yīnjié chuándá de zīxùn hěnshǎo;
passage.en: They found that each Spanish syllable conveys very little information;

passage.zh: 相對地，華語每個音節裡包含了較多資訊，可能是因為華語的音節還帶有四聲。
passage.py: Xiāngduì de, Huáyǔ měi ge yīnjié lǐ bāohán le jiào duō zīxùn, kěnéng shìyīnwèi Huáyǔ de yīnjié hái dàiyǒu sìshēng.
passage.en: in contrast, each Chinese syllable contains more information, possibly because Chinese syllables also carry four tones.

passage.zh: 但是，對聽話的人來說，結果卻是西班牙語和華語傳達資訊的速度一樣。
passage.py: Dànshì, duì tīnghuà de rén láishuō, jiéguǒ quèshì Xībānyáyǔ hé Huáyǔ chuándá zīxùn de sùdù yíyàng.
passage.en: But for the listener, the result was that Spanish and Chinese convey information at the same speed.

passage.zh: 研究人員認為，各語言傳達資訊的速度是一樣的，可能和人類的感覺系統接收資料的速度與資料量有關。
passage.py: Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi, gè yǔyán chuándá zīxùn de sùdù shì yíyàng de, kěnéng hé rénlèi de gǎnjué xìtǒng jiēshōu zīliào de sùdù yǔ zīliào liàng yǒuguān.
passage.en: The researchers believe that the speed at which languages convey information is the same, which may be related to the speed and amount of data the human sensory system can take in.

passage.zh: 1950 年代，語言學家喬姆斯基提出了「普遍語法概念」，他認為儘管各種語言聽起來都不同，卻具有共通的語法結構。
passage.py: 1950 niándài, yǔyánxuéjiā Qiáomǔsījī tíchū le “Pǔbiàn yǔfǎ gàiniàn”, tā rènwéi jǐnguǎn gèzhǒng yǔyán tīng qǐlái dōu bùtóng, què jùyǒu gòngtōng de yǔfǎjiégòu.
passage.en: In the 1950s, linguist Chomsky proposed the concept of "universal grammar"; he believed that although all languages sound different, they share a common grammatical structure.

passage.zh: 這個說法鼓舞了語言學界，但要找到真正的共同結構，卻比想像中困難。
passage.py: Zhè ge shuōfǎ gǔwǔ le yǔyán xuéjiè, dàn yào zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de gòngtóng jiégòu, què bǐ xiǎngxiàngzhōng kùnnán.
passage.en: This idea inspired the field of linguistics, but finding a truly common structure has been harder than imagined.

passage.zh: 但就上述的研究顯示，各語言都在確保說話者與聽者之間能穩定的交流，所以，自 1950 年後科學家找出了各語言間的共同結構為，不論何種語言其傳達給聽者的資訊速度皆是固定的，這將會進一步改變我們對全球語言多樣性的看法。
passage.py: Dàn jiù shàngshù de yánjiū xiǎnshì, gè yǔyán dōu zài quèbǎo shuōhuà zhě yǔ tīngzhě zhījiān néng wěndìng de jiāoliú, suǒyǐ, zì 1950 nián hòu kēxuéjiā zhǎochū le gè yǔyán jiān de gòngtóng jiégòu wéi, búlùn hézhǒng yǔyán qí chuándá gěi tīngzhě de zīxùn sùdù jiē shì gùdìng de, zhè jiāng huì jìnyíbù gǎibiàn wǒmen duì quánqiú yǔyán duōyàngxìng de kànfǎ.
passage.en: However, the research above shows that every language ensures stable communication between speaker and listener; so the common structure scientists have found among languages since 1950 is that, whatever the language, the speed at which it conveys information to the listener is fixed. This will further change how we view the diversity of the world's languages.

stem.zh: 根據研究報告，下面哪一種語言的速度最慢？
stem.py: Gēnjù yánjiū bàogào, xiàmiàn nǎ yìzhǒng yǔyán de sùdù zuìmàn?
stem.en: According to the research report, which language is the slowest?

stem.zh: 研究人員認為華語包含較多訊息量和什麼有關？
stem.py: Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi Huáyǔ bāohán jiào duō xùnxī liàng hé shénme yǒuguān?
stem.en: What do the researchers think the larger amount of information in Chinese is related to?

stem.zh: 這個研究的結果是什麼？
stem.py: Zhè ge yánjiū de jiéguǒ shì shénme?
stem.en: What was the result of this study?

A.zh: 語言之間沒有共同結構

B.py: Xùnxī liàng duōguǎ hé yǔsù méiyǒu guānxì
B.en: (B) The amount of information has nothing to do with speech rate.

C.zh: 語速的快慢與音節數多寡相反
C.py: Yǔsù de kuàimàn yǔ yīnjié shù duōguǎ xiāngfǎn
C.en: (C) Speech rate is the inverse of the number of syllables.

D.zh: 七種語言中，只有華語帶有語調
D.py: Qīzhǒng yǔyán zhōng, zhǐyǒu Huáyǔ dàiyǒu yǔdiào
D.en: (D) Of the seven languages, only Chinese has intonation.

stem.zh: 作者於文中提到「普遍語法概念」，他想表達什麼？
stem.py: Zuòzhě yú wénzhōng tídào “Pǔbiàn yǔfǎ gàiniàn”, tā xiǎng biǎodá shénme?
stem.en: When the author mentions the "concept of universal grammar," what does he want to express?

A.en: (A) He thinks grammatical concepts are the key to communication.

B.py: Tā xiǎng shuōmíng yǔfǎ yǔ yǔyán xùnxī de guānxì
B.en: (B) He wants to explain the relation between grammar and linguistic information.

C.zh: 他認同語言學家長久以來的貢獻
C.py: Tā rèntóng yǔyánxuéjiā chángjiǔyǐlái de gòngxiàn

D.zh: 他認為語言之間確實有共同結構
D.py: Tā rènwéi yǔyán zhījiān quèshí yǒu gòngtóng jiégòu
D.en: (D) He thinks languages really do share a common structure.

passage.zh: （十二）
passage.py: (Shí'èr)

passage.zh: 導演曾說，他最欣賞《水滸傳》裡的〈林沖夜奔〉。
passage.py: Dǎoyǎn céng shuō, tā zuì xīnshǎng «Shuǐhǔzhuàn» lǐ de 〈 Línchōng yè bēn 〉.
passage.en: The director once said that what he admired most in "Water Margin" was "Lin Chong Flees by Night."

passage.zh: 林沖不管遭遇多少不公不義的事情，都不和現實低頭妥協，這份精神，正是一個文化的價值所在，也是導演在電影裡最想呈現的部分。
passage.py: Línchōng bùguǎn zāoyù duōshǎo bùgōng búyì de shìqing, dōu bù hé xiànshí dītóu tuǒxié, zhèfèn jīngshén, zhèngshì yí ge wénhuà de jiàzhí suǒzài, yě shì dǎoyǎn zài diànyǐng lǐ zuì xiǎng chéngxiàn de bùfèn.
passage.en: No matter how much injustice Lin Chong suffered, he never bowed to reality or compromised. This spirit is exactly where the value of a culture lies, and it's also what the director most wants to show in his films.

passage.zh: 也許因為這個堅持，讓他在面對國家電影審查制度時，總是挫折不斷。
passage.py: Yěxǔ yīnwèi zhè ge jiānchí, ràng tā zài miànduì guójiā diànyǐng shěnchá zhìdù shí, zǒngshì cuòzhé búduàn.
passage.en: Perhaps because of this persistence, he has always met setback after setback when facing the national film censorship system.

passage.zh: 導演對此曾表示，他所追尋的「創作自由」，就是不被國家政策干擾、限制的自由。
passage.py: Dǎoyǎn duìcǐ céng biǎoshì, tā suǒ zhuīxún de “Chuàngzuòzìyóu”, jiùshì bú bèi guójiā zhèngcè gānrǎo, xiànzhì de zìyóu.
passage.en: The director once said that the "creative freedom" he pursues is freedom from interference and restriction by state policy.

passage.zh: 但從近幾年的作品來看，他已經有了不同的想法，如他自己所說：「人最終要面對的不是外在的一切，而是自己。」
passage.py: Dàn cóng jìnjǐnián de zuòpǐn láikàn, tā yǐjīng yǒu le bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ, rútā zìjǐ suǒshuō: “Rén zuìzhōng yào miànduì de búshì wàizài de yíqiè, érshì zìjǐ.”
passage.en: But judging from his works in recent years, he has come to think differently. As he himself put it: "In the end what people must face is not everything outside, but themselves."

passage.zh: 當年他離開自己生長的土地，離開那些從小一起相處的親人，一頭往大城市裡栽進去，在追尋著電影夢的同時，卻忽略了他的母親在長期的孤單寂寞中，已經開始出現喃喃自語的症狀。
passage.py: Dāngnián tā líkāi zìjǐ shēngzhǎng de tǔdì, líkāi nàxiē cóngxiǎo yìqǐ xiāngchǔ de qīnrén, yìtóu wǎng Dàchéngshì lǐ zāijìnqù, zài zhuīxún zhe diànyǐng mèng de tóngshí, què hūlüè le tā de mǔqīn zài chángqī de gūdān jìmò zhōng, yǐjīng kāishǐ chūxiàn nánnánzìyǔ de zhèngzhuàng.
passage.en: Back then he left the land where he grew up and the relatives he'd been with since childhood, and threw himself headlong into the big city. While chasing his film dream, he overlooked that his mother, after long loneliness, had begun to show symptoms of talking to herself.

passage.zh: 當導演發覺到這些問題時，他感到失落、傷心，並將這些情緒拍進了這部電影中。
passage.py: Dāng dǎoyǎn fājué dào zhèxiē wèntí shí, tā gǎndào shīluò, shāngxīn, bìng jiāng zhèxiē qíngxù pāijìn le zhèbù diànyǐng zhōng.
passage.en: When the director became aware of these problems, he felt lost and sad, and he put these emotions into this film.

passage.zh: 這部電影描述了生活在這個國家的群體，沒有人對生活有安全感。
passage.py: Zhèbù diànyǐng miáoshù le shēnghuó zài zhè ge guójiā de qúntǐ, méiyǒu rén duì shēnghuó yǒu Ānquángǎn.
passage.en: The film depicts a population living in this country where no one feels secure about life.

passage.zh: 不論是誰，都有可能今天是個成功的人，明天就成了犯人。
passage.py: Búlùnshìshuí, dōu yǒu kěnéng jīntiān shì gè chénggōng de rén, míngtiān jiù chéng le fànrén.
passage.en: Whoever you are, you might be a success today and a criminal tomorrow.

passage.zh: 就是這種不安的情緒，完整地傳達了導演的意識：所有外在的一切都會消失，只有故人的情感會被永遠地留下。
passage.py: Jiùshì zhèzhǒng bù'ān de qíngxù, wánzhěng de chuándá le dǎoyǎn de yìshí: Suǒyǒu wàizài de yíqiè dōu huì xiāoshī, zhǐyǒu gùrén de qínggǎn huì bèi yǒngyuǎn de liúxià.
passage.en: It is this feeling of unease that fully conveys the director's awareness: everything external will disappear; only the feelings of people from the past will remain forever.
